'''Outpost C-2''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located in the [[Carba Asteroid Belt]] in the [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana system]]. It was staffed by a mixture of [[Human/Legends|Human]] agents and [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], and a [[4C observation droid]]. Outpost C-2 would analyze the data it received and prioritized the information before sending it on to [[Oracle Base]]. While the droids at [[Outpost C-1]] did not forward information on a "hunch," Outpost C-2 could react to information requiring an immediate response much faster.
